_readme: One entry per model. tier is one of: frontier, free-tier, self-hosted. price is USD per million tokens (0 for free-tier and self-hosted). toolMode: 'native' uses the endpoint's tool calling; 'json' is for models without it. contextTokens makes the runner drop old tool output before the window fills. Model names change often: check the provider's current list and edit 'model'. Set 'enabled' to true once the entry is real.

ollama-local.label: FILL: local model name
ollama-local.model: FILL: the tag you pulled, for example from `ollama list`

lmstudio-local.label: FILL: local model name
lmstudio-local.model: FILL: the model id LM Studio shows

openrouter-free.label: FILL: a free model from the provider's list
openrouter-free.model: FILL: a model id ending in :free

openrouter-frontier.label: FILL: a frontier model, to compare in the same harness
openrouter-frontier.model: FILL: the provider's id for that model
